AWPTCM-T33235.objective:
• A port configured to a fixed speed establishes a link at exactly the configured speed with a compliant partner.
  • A port configured to a fixed speed and duplex (full or half) reports the configured fixed values (not Auto) in interface status.
  • Link establishment succeeds at supported fixed speeds (e.g. 10, 100, 1000) with matching partner settings.
  • When an unsupported speed is configured, the link does not come up or is correctly reported as down.
  • Hot-insert of a supported pluggable while the port is in fixed speed mode results in link coming up at the configured fixed rate.
  • Show interface and status commands accurately reflect the fixed speed, duplex, and current link state.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability

Set the port to a supported fixed speed and full duplex (e.g. 1000/Full). Confirm the link comes up at exactly that speed/duplex, the port reports the fixed speed (not Auto), and traffic can be forwarded.
Repeat for other supported fixed speeds on the media type (100/Full, 1000/Full, etc. as applicable). Confirm link establishment at the exact configured rate and correct reporting in each case.
Test fixed speed with half and full duplex where supported. Confirm correct link-up and reporting for each duplex setting at the fixed speed.
Configure an unsupported speed on the port (or force mismatch with partner). Confirm link does not come up or is reported down, and status reflects the misconfiguration.

Hot-insert / hot-remove supported pluggables or change cables while port is set to fixed speed. Confirm link state updates correctly and fixed configuration is retained after re-insertion where applicable.
Verify show interface and related status commands accurately reflect the fixed speed/duplex configuration and current link state.
